extracted.intended_audience: organizations and entities seeking DOE Integrated Energy Systems Office funding (industries, universities, national labs, governments, NGOs, advocacy groups)
extracted.subtask_description: A directory-style page listing open, upcoming, and closed funding opportunities administered or highlighted by the U.S. DOE Integrated Energy Systems Office (IESO), with links to notices, due dates, and related application resources. Intended to help prospective applicants find solicitations and basic eligibility/administrative information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open, competitive solicitation process
rubrics_metrics.description: Following an open, competitive solicitation process, these funding opportunities encourage collaborative partnerships among industries, universities, national laboratories, federal, state, and local governments, non-government agencies, and advocacy groups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page emphasizes that awards are generally made through open competition; applicants should expect formal solicitations (e.g., FOAs, funding notices, prize competitions) with defined submission/selection processes and should prepare competitive proposals that respond to solicitation requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Encouraged collaborative partnerships / eligible participants
rubrics_metrics.description: These funding opportunities encourage collaborative partnerships among industries, universities, national laboratories, federal, state, and local governments, non-government agencies, and advocacy groups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals that demonstrate collaboration across the listed sectors (industry, academia, national labs, government entities, NGOs, advocacy groups) align with the office's stated aims; applicants should explicitly describe team composition, roles, and partnership value in submissions if a solicitation emphasizes collaboration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award types may include financial or technical assistance
rubrics_metrics.description: Solicitations may include financial or technical assistance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should note that the form of support can vary by opportunity (grants, cooperative agreements, technical assistance, vouchers, prizes, incubator support). Carefully review each solicitation to understand the award instrument, funding limits, and obligations tied to that instrument.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adhere to posted application deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: Open Funding Opportunities are listed with application due dates (e.g., 'Applications due by May 13, 2026').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Timely submission is required; applicants must follow the specific deadline for each solicitation. Check each opportunity's page for exact submission instructions and any required pre-application steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recognize different solicitation mechanisms (FOA, Funding Notice, Prize, Incubator, Voucher)
rubrics_metrics.description: The page catalogs various mechanisms such as Notice of Funding Opportunity, Funding Notice, Prize competitions (e.g., American-Made prizes), incubator programs, and voucher opportunities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each mechanism has different eligibility, evaluation, and award procedures—e.g., FOAs usually follow grant/cooperative agreement rules, prizes have competition rules and milestones, vouchers may involve a provider/recipient relationship. Applicants must review the specific solicitation documents for mechanism-specific criteria and application requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use linked resources for application procedures and broader program lists
rubrics_metrics.description: Related resources are linked: 'How to Apply for a Funding Opportunity Announcement (FOA)', 'Energy-Related Federal Financial Assistance Programs', and 'DOE Funding Opportunity Exchange' for a complete list of past and current opportunities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page functions as an index; applicants should follow the 'Learn More' links to access procedural guidance (how to apply), eligibility rules, and the DOE-wide Funding Opportunity Exchange to ensure they identify all relevant solicitations and understand formal application requirements.
